generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Person {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  firstName String
  lastName  String?
  gender    String?
  birthDate String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) - date only, no time
  deathDate String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) - date only, no time
  notes     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // External ID for GEDCOM import/export
  externalId String? @unique

  // Relationships where this person is the parent
  parentOf ParentChild[] @relation("ParentRelation")
  // Relationships where this person is the child  
  childOf  ParentChild[] @relation("ChildRelation")

  // Family relationships
  familiesAsPartner1 Family[] @relation("Partner1")
  familiesAsPartner2 Family[] @relation("Partner2")

  // Source citations for this person
  citations SourceCitation[]

  // Media attached to this person
  media ObjectMedia[]
}

model ParentChild {
  id       String @id @default(cuid())
  parentId String
  childId  String

  parent Person @relation("ParentRelation", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  child  Person @relation("ChildRelation", fields: [childId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([parentId, childId])
}

model Family {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String?
  marriageDate String? // ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) - date only, no time
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  // External ID for GEDCOM import/export
  externalId String? @unique

  partner1Id String?
  partner2Id String?

  partner1 Person? @relation("Partner1", fields: [partner1Id], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  partner2 Person? @relation("Partner2", fields: [partner2Id], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  // Source citations for this family
  citations SourceCitation[]

  // Media attached to this family
  media ObjectMedia[]
}

// Source records (GEDCOM SOUR)
model Source {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // External ID for GEDCOM import/export (e.g., "@S1@")
  externalId String? @unique

  // Source identification
  title       String? // TITL - Descriptive title
  author      String? // AUTH - Author/creator
  publication String? // PUBL - Publication info
  repository  String? // REPO reference (stored as text for now)

  // Source content
  text String? // TEXT - Verbatim text from source

  // Citations referencing this source
  citations SourceCitation[]
}

// Citation linking sources to persons/families (GEDCOM SOUR reference within records)
model SourceCitation {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // The source being cited
  sourceId String
  source   Source @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Where in the source (page, volume, etc.)
  page String? // PAGE - Location within source

  // Citation-specific data
  data String? // DATA.TEXT - Data from this specific citation

  // What this citation is for (one of these will be set)
  personId String?
  person   Person? @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  familyId String?
  family   Family? @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Could also cite specific events - for now we attach to person/family level

  @@index([sourceId])
  @@index([personId])
  @@index([familyId])
}

// Multimedia objects (GEDCOM OBJE)
model MultimediaObject {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // External ID for GEDCOM import/export (e.g., "@M1@")
  externalId String? @unique

  // File information
  filePath  String // FILE - Path or reference to the file
  mediaType String? // FORM.MEDI - Media type (photo, document, etc.)
  format    String? // FORM - File format (jpg, pdf, etc.)

  // Descriptive information
  title String? // TITL - Title of the multimedia object

  // Links to records
  linkedRecords ObjectMedia[]
}

// Junction table for multimedia links to persons/families
model ObjectMedia {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  // The multimedia object
  objectId String
  object   MultimediaObject @relation(fields: [objectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // What this media is attached to (one of these will be set)
  personId String?
  person   Person? @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  familyId String?
  family   Family? @relation(fields: [familyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([objectId])
  @@index([personId])
  @@index([familyId])
}
</result>

## Codebase Summary: Vamsa

**Vamsa** is a genealogy/family tree application built with modern web technologies.

### Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15.1.4 with React 19
- **Runtime**: Bun (for scripts, testing, package management)
- **Database**: SQLite via Prisma ORM
- **UI**: Radix UI components, Tailwind CSS 4.0
- **Testing**: Bun test runner (unit), Playwright (E2E)
- **State Management**: TanStack React Query

### Core Features
1. **Person Management**: Create, edit, view individuals with birth/death dates, gender, notes
2. **Family Relationships**: Parent-child relationships, partner/marriage tracking
3. **Family Tree Visualization**: D3-hierarchy based tree rendering
4. **GEDCOM Import/Export**: Standard genealogy file format support (5.5.1)
5. **Backup System**: Data backup and restore functionality

### Database Models
- **Person**: Individual records with external ID support for GEDCOM
- **Family**: Marriage/partnership units
- **ParentChild**: Junction table for parent-child relationships
- **Source**: GEDCOM source records (citations, publications)
- **SourceCitation**: Links sources to persons/families
- **MultimediaObject**: Photos, documents (GEDCOM OBJE)
- **ObjectMedia**: Junction table for media attachments

### Project Structure
- `/src/app/` - Next.js App Router pages
- `/src/actions/` - Server actions (person, family, backup, import/export)
- `/src/components/` - React components (UI primitives, person, family, dates)
- `/src/lib/` - Core libraries (GEDCOM parser/generator, backup, storage)
- `/prisma/` - Database schema and migrations
- `/e2e/` - Playwright end-to-end tests
- `/scripts/` - Development and testing scripts

### Current Work
The project is actively developing GEDCOM support with Phase 2 (sources and media) completed. Phase 3 planning includes character encoding, GEDCOM 7.0 support, and additional record types.

### Critical Files for Implementation
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/prisma/schema.prisma` - Database schema defining all models
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/lib/gedcom/parser.ts` - GEDCOM file parsing logic
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/lib/gedcom/generator.ts` - GEDCOM file generation
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/actions/person.ts` - Person CRUD server actions
- `/Users/rambhiad/Code/Repositories/personal-projects/vamsa/src/components/family/family-tree-view.tsx` - Tree visualization component
